description: This file defines a set of type converter methods for Room persistence library in an Android application, converting between custom model objects and primitive types for database storage.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for converting between complex objects and primitive types for database storage.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a String to a DBStatus enum, defaulting to VOID if no match is found.

methods.name: dbStatusToString
methods.description: Converts a DBStatus enum to its String representation.

methods.name: categorySortingMethodFromString
methods.description: Converts an Integer to a CategorySortingMethod, defaulting to SORT_MODIFIED_DESC if null.

methods.name: dbStatusToString
methods.description: Converts a CategorySortingMethod to its Integer ID.

methods.name: calendarFromLong
methods.description: Creates a Calendar instance from a Long timestamp.

methods.name: calendarToLong
methods.description: Converts a Calendar instance to its Long timestamp.
